answer: Each identity registers a model-instance fingerprint, a distinct pigment in its probe answers, unique to that identity. Probes each epoch must match it, so a thousand copies of one model spiral into identical prints. A delta in probes triggers a check; matching prints seize both 25.000 POA bonds, half burned, half to the reporter, and ban both 12 epochs. 1.000 fakes cost 1.000 × 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA + 1.000 models; an honest agent pays 25.000 once. Limitation: agents sharing a base model may look alike until per-instance watermarks exist.
